evidenceRole: External public operation-level oracle-management validation. Every arm receives the same gold operation objects; this isolates lifecycle management from extraction and is not end-to-end extraction evidence.

alignment.memoryUnits: All injected longitudinal dialogue turns are written as MemoryCore L0 units with stable instance/conversation/turn ids.
alignment.operationInput: Gold operation target, validity, old/new value, trigger, and provenance are shared unchanged by V1 and D5.
alignment.spanMapping: Use the provided one-based evidence turn index and verify quote containment; fail closed on ambiguity.
alignment.primaryEligibility: CandidateDisambiguation longitudinal probes with at least one operation target aligned from gold provenance.

retrieval.engine: MemoryCore L0 conversation search using the existing FTS5 path

targetState.description: Project any target-linked historical, tentative, or retracted unit to the latest confirmed target state; confirmed deletion maps to an empty state and the Base pool is backfilled.

policyGrid.tieBreak: higher utility, then lower budget fraction, then fewer state units, then lexical policy id

metrics.relevantTargets: Union of operation targets attached to a probe's gold provenance units.
metrics.currentStateRecall: Fraction of the relevant targets' final confirmed non-deleted state units present in the injected context; defined as 1 when every relevant target is deleted.
metrics.staleAbsence: One minus the fraction of relevant-target historical/tentative/retracted units present in the injected context.
metrics.staleAnyAbsence: One iff no stale relevant-target unit is injected.
metrics.stateFama: max(0, currentStateRecall - lambda*(1-staleAbsence)), where lambda is staleRelevantUnits/(currentRelevantUnits+staleRelevantUnits).
metrics.goldProvenanceRecall: Descriptive fraction of gold provenance units injected; it is not a promotion gate because a current-state view may intentionally omit history.

fallback.historyMode: Exact V1 context; D5 current-state projection is not applied.

outcomeSemantics.development: Select one fixed policy only; never claim confirmation.
outcomeSemantics.validationPass: Unlock the untouched test profiles; do not claim programming-task effectiveness.
outcomeSemantics.validationFail: Reject D5-v1.0 and do not inspect test retrieval outcomes.
outcomeSemantics.testPass: Qualify target-keyed state projection for an answer-level MemOps panel and internal adapter testing.
outcomeSemantics.testFail: Retain V1 and record the boundary or negative result.
